description:
The development team for 'acmecorp.test' manages a backend worker service named 'acmecorp-worker'. They need the ability to restart this service through the Virtualmin interface without having SSH or sudo access.

Your task is to:
1. Grant the 'acmecorp' administration user access to the 'Custom Commands' Webmin module.
2. Create a new Custom Command with the description 'Restart Backend Service' that executes the command: 'systemctl restart acmecorp-worker'.
3. Ensure this command runs as 'root' (so it has permission to restart services).
4. Assign this command specifically to the 'acmecorp' user so they can use it.

After completion, the acmecorp user should be able to access the Custom Commands module and see the button to restart their service.
